definition.grid: tracks A (authors' data) and B (our data) x clusters 0-3 x eta {10, 1, 0.1, 0.01} x seeds 0-4; everything else as scripts/10_trackA_cvae.py and 30_trackB_models.py. Extension beyond the brief (column in_specified_grid = False): eta {0.03, 0.003, 0.001}, same seeds and settings
definition.train_kl: mean over the 273 training days of the analytic KL(q(z|x,c) || N(0, I)), nats
definition.active_units: latent dims whose posterior mean has variance > 0.01 across training days
definition.agg_post: aggregate posterior over training days: mean of posterior means; variance = Var(mu) + mean(sd^2) per dim (N(0, I) prior: 0 and 1)
definition.rmse_median_kwh / es_median / vg_median: medians over the 92 test days; 200 samples per day with the fixed z draws default_rng([20200801, cluster]); RMSE root-mean over 48 half-hours; ES eq. 14 (N/2 split, Euclidean, kWh); VG p = 0.5, ordered pairs
definition.spread_skill: pooled over 92 x 48 cells: sqrt(mean sample variance, ddof 1) x sqrt((N+1)/N) / RMS error of the sample mean (1 = calibrated)
definition.coverage50 / coverage90: share of (day, half-hour) observations inside the central 50% / 90% sample interval
definition.aggz_*: diagnostic: z drawn from the training days' aggregate posterior instead of N(0, I)
definition.eff_*_pct (cluster 3): 100 x mean over test days and window slots of (scenario - Normal) / mean of Normal; Low = low 9-18, High = high 39-43; pre4 = slots 35-38, post4 = 44-47; same z
definition.*_rel_change_vs_eta10_pct: paired by seed (same init and noise streams), 100 x (value / value at eta 10 - 1)
definition.medians: median over the 5 seeds; ranges = [min, max] over seeds

stored_checks.definition: stored restarts outputs/track{A,B}/models/cvae_c<c>_s<ss>.pt (eta = 10) re-evaluated with this script's own encoder on the training days; active unit = variance over training days of the posterior mean > 0.01; selected-model samples = outputs/track{A,B}/cvae_samples_c<c>.npy scored with this script's own score code
